issues.summary: Harbor Gate Customs Brokerage filed the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260013 / MBL HMLU260481 (container HMLU6383102) under HS 8482.99 instead of the historically used HS 8482.10 without prior written confirmation, causing a duty difference of about USD 380 disputed by Daehan Precision Co.

decisions.summary: Keep the filed HS 8482.99 for HBL MFCIM260013 and not pursue an amendment of the declaration.

Record a non-conformance against Harbor Gate Customs Brokerage for filing the HS code change without written confirmation, requiring any future classification change to be confirmed in writing before filing.

tasks.summary: Inform Soyeon Moon at Daehan Precision that HS 8482.99 is kept for HBL MFCIM260013 with no amendment and a non-conformance was recorded against the broker.
